title: Holes tool (teardrop / bore-pocket / rim)
status: merged (user-verified 2026-10-15) as 098e627827; fix2 (rim side selectable + Place-on-face gated to bore) merged as 61f46aabff, user-verified; fix3 (teardrop horizontal-only, Custom sizes, Head/Fit highlight) merged as 030e512e89, user-verified; screw-teardrop (teardrop a screw's clearance bore, optional head on the same row, shared apex) merged as be3367cdeb, user-verified; fix4 (round features under a non-uniform instance scale; only bore/pocket stays world-round - teardrop/rim/fill object-space, nut fill fixed) merged as 9df5069703, user-verified 2026-10-16; chamfer-fillet (Rim chamfer/fillet merged into one Chamfer/Fillet op + Both ends checkbox) on port/ME-2-chamfer-fillet, pending user test
notes: Detects cylindrical walls and applies one operation volume per hole: teardrop (horizontal only), bore/pocket (screw / insert / magnet / nut / custom), rim chamfer / fillet; bore/pocket also authorable on any flat face. Shrinking adds a positive annulus (its_make_shrink_tube) whose caps land exactly on the detected wall's ends, so it comes out flush with the faces the hole was bored through. No keys, no CAD. See notes/ME-2.md. FIX2 (2026-10-15, patch 32_ME-2-fix2.patch): the rim chamfer/fillet had no Flip (entry) control - it rendered inside the bore branch only - so on a detected hole (axis sign ignores the material) the ring was stuck on one mouth; Flip now renders for bore and rim (a teardrop is centred on the hole and ignores the entry). Place on face, which stamped the current operation's shape onto a bare face, now shows only for bore/pocket: set_place_face_mode refuses it for other operations and set_operation exits the mode when leaving bore. FIX3 (2026-10-15, patch 33_ME-2-fix3.patch): teardrop now offers horizontal holes only (a hole_usable() gate on the previews, hover and count; a near-vertical detected axis previously built a teardrop ghost with a garbage up direction). The standard combo gained a Custom entry and is_screw/is_nut/is_pocket now derive from the category, so editing the diameter to a non-catalogue size no longer shows M2/M3 or turns a nut into a circle; the standalone Custom category button is removed (size-only Custom: no screw head styles, no nut clearance bore). Head and Fit buttons now highlight the active choice. FEAT (2026-10-15, patch 34_ME-2-teardrop.patch): bore/pocket Screw gets a Teardrop checkbox (shaft only by default), a Teardrop-head checkbox for a counterbore, sharing the Teardrop operation's apex angle. New libslic3r its_make_teardrop_prism generalizes its_make_teardrop_for_hole onto any axis; a vertical hole falls back to round. FIX4 (2026-10-15, patch 35_ME-2-scale.patch): features are built in world space and pulled back through instance_matrix().inverse(), so a non-uniform instance scale no longer flattens them into ellipses (the ME-2d object_scale division only held for a uniform scale). Rim/shrink radii from an elliptical hole stay approximate. FIX5 (2026-10-16, patch 37_ME-2-chamfer-fillet.patch): the two rim operations are merged into one Chamfer/Fillet op (Teardrop | Bore/Pocket | Chamfer/Fillet) with a Chamfer|Fillet toggle (default chamfer), a size field and a Both ends checkbox that rims both mouths of a through hole; Flip hides when Both ends is on. Volume names unchanged. FIX4b (2026-10-16, patch 36_ME-2-fill.patch): only bore/pocket is built round-in-world (teardrop/rim follow the hole's own edge in object space again), and the shrink fill is object space so it fills the stretched wall exactly and now covers nuts too (inner wall inside the world-round bore's object ellipse).
